company.name: Unthread
company.shortDescription: Unthread is an AI-powered support platform built into Slack.
company.description: Unthread offers a slack inbox for customer support teams to assign, prioritize, and escalate inbound requests entirely within slack. It also includes assigning, triaging, escalating, collaborating, educating, and measuring, enabling clients to easily integrate their services for business planning and prioritization.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based support and service-management platform that centralizes tickets, AI resolution, knowledge, workflows, analytics, and on-call operations across Slack and other channels.
productsAndServices.name: Unthread AI Helpdesk

productsAndServices.description: An AI agent that classifies, routes, answers, and resolves support requests using company knowledge, ticket context, connected tools, and configurable prompts.
productsAndServices.name: Agentic AI

productsAndServices.description: A Slack-native ticketing product for creating, assigning, tracking, responding to, and closing support conversations directly in channels, DMs, and threads.
productsAndServices.name: Slack Support

productsAndServices.description: A shared email and Slack inbox that converts incoming messages into collaborative ticket threads and allows teams to reply from Slack.
productsAndServices.name: Shared Inbox

productsAndServices.description: A workflow automation system for routing tickets, triggering multi-step actions, integrating APIs, and executing operational processes from Slack or other supported channels.
productsAndServices.name: Automations

productsAndServices.description: A self-updating knowledge-management system that uses support conversations and resolved tickets to draft, update, and serve documentation.
productsAndServices.name: Knowledge Base
